name: 曼宁公式明渠流量计算器

map.由糙率 n、过水断面 A、水力半径 R 与底坡 S，按 Q=(1/n)A·R^(: Compute open-channel uniform-flow discharge Q = (1/n)*A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S) from roughness n, cross-sectional area A, hydraulic radius R and bed slope S.
map.水力半径 R = A/P（P 为湿周）。: Hydraulic radius R = A/P (P is wetted perimeter).
For uniform flow; n values: concrete 0.012–0.015, natural channel 0.025–0.035.
map.天然河道与人工渠按曼宁算流速流量。: Estimate velocity and discharge of natural rivers and artificial canals by Manning.
map.整治断面后输水能力评估。: Assess conveyance capacity after section remediation.
map.S 翻倍到 0.002，v 增约 41%，同断面过流能力明显提高。: Doubling S to 0.002 raises v by about 41%, noticeably increasing conveyance of the same section.
map.水力半径=过水面积/湿周，宽浅渠近似水深，圆管满流为 D/4。: Hydraulic radius = flow area / wetted perimeter; for wide-shallow channels it approximates depth, and for a full circular pipe it is D/4.
map.0.012~0.015、土渠 0.02~0.03、植被渠更大，按护面查表。: 0.012~0.015, earth canal 0.02~0.03, vegetated canal larger; look up by lining type.
